'''Fervorborn Staff''' is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Flame of Fervor]], a [[boss]] in the [[Domain of Fear]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +15
:[[Holy damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Smiting Prayers]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:[[Energy]] +5 (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Enchantments]] last 20% longer

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Winged Staff]].

==Replica==
It is possible to create an exact replica for this item with:
*[[Winged Staff]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], or [[Soros]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Insightful]] [[Staff Head]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Enchanting]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Hale and Hearty]]" inscription

*[[Perfect]] [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Enchanting]]
OR
*One of the following [[Smiting Prayers]] [[staves]]:

*[[Divine Ghostly Staff]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts [[Fire damage]] and requires [[Divine Favor]].
